description: This file defines function prototypes, type structures, and include guards for reporting and survey functionalities within a Wi-Fi management system. It mainly declares interfaces related to reporting tasks, survey reports, client reports, and neighbor reports, as well as external dependencies and C linkage.

methods.name: sm_report_start_task
methods.description: Starts a reporting task with specified statistics type, application context, and request state.

methods.name: sm_report_config_task
methods.description: Configures a reporting task for a specific application, request state, and configuration.

methods.name: sm_report_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes and cleans up resources associated with reporting for a given application.

methods.name: sm_report_init
methods.description: Initializes reporting subsystem for the provided application.

methods.name: sm_report_send_to_qm_cb
methods.description: Callback function to send report data to Quality Management (QM).

methods.name: survey_report_counter_publish_cb
methods.description: Callback for publishing survey report counters.

methods.name: sm_client_report_push_to_dpp
methods.description: Pushes client report data to a DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol) context for a specific frequency band.

methods.name: sm_survey_report_push_to_dpp
methods.description: Pushes survey report data to DPP for a specific survey and report type.

methods.name: sm_neighbor_report_push_to_dpp
methods.description: Pushes neighbor report data to DPP for a specific frequency band.
